# The Guardian

> Global news organization delivering breaking news, investigative journalism, opinion, and analysis across politics, world events, sports, culture, and lifestyle.

The Guardian operates multiple regional editions (US, UK, Australia, Europe, International) providing localized coverage while maintaining global perspective. The site emphasizes commentary, analysis, and in-depth reporting on major geopolitical issues including the Iran-Israel conflict, US politics, Ukraine war, and climate crisis.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Iran-Israel conflict
- US politics
- Middle East crisis
- Ukraine war
- Immigration policy
- Climate crisis
- UK politics
- Breaking news
- Opinion commentary
- World news
- Energy prices
- European politics
- Current events
- Daily news

## Homepage & Regional Editions

- [The Guardian Homepage](https://www.theguardian.com): Main homepage with breaking news and world coverage
- [US Edition](https://www.theguardian.com/us): US edition homepage with latest news, sports, and opinion coverage
- [UK Edition](https://www.theguardian.com/preference/edition/uk): UK edition preference page with news, business, and health coverage
- [Australia Edition](https://www.theguardian.com/preference/edition/au): Guardian Australia edition with local and international news
- [Europe Edition](https://www.theguardian.com/preference/edition/eur): European edition covering Middle East, UK politics, and business news
- [International Edition](https://www.theguardian.com/preference/edition/int): International edition with global news and Iran-Israel conflict coverage

## News Coverage

- [US News](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news): US news section covering Trump administration and immigration policy
- [US Politics](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/us-politics): US politics coverage with Trump administration and Senate confirmation news
- [World News](https://www.theguardian.com/world): Global news aggregator covering Africa, world events, and international developments
- [Middle East & North Africa](https://www.theguardian.com/world/middleeast): Middle East coverage of Iran-Israel conflict and geopolitical tensions
- [Ukraine](https://www.theguardian.com/world/ukraine): Ukraine war coverage including EU aid and Russian conflict updates
- [US Immigration](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/usimmigration): US immigration coverage including ICE raids and border enforcement news

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Comment is Free](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree): Opinion section featuring columnists and discussion from Guardian journalists

## Sports, Culture & Lifestyle

- [Sports](https://www.theguardian.com/sport): Sports coverage including NBA, NCAA Tournament, and Premier League analysis
- [Culture](https://www.theguardian.com/culture): Culture section with music, film reviews, and entertainment news
- [Life and Style](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle): Lifestyle hub covering wellness, relationships, homes, and personal style

## Environment & Climate

- [Climate Crisis](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/climate-crisis): Climate coverage including tropical weather events and renewable energy

## Newsletters & Engagement

- [Email Newsletters](https://www.theguardian.com/email-newsletters): Newsletter signup hub featuring curated content from Guardian journalists
